verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no in-product AI that analyzes a user's own account or portfolio data to produce insights or suggestions. AI Domain Search only generates name suggestions from a typed keyword, which is an adjacent search feature. The MCP server lets an external AI assistant read account info, so the AI runs outside the product rather than inside it.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
